messages:
maria: routing-sentinel is failing to deliver pages to the paging gateway. noticed gaps starting ~12:28 UTC, affected Dedicated customers got no pages. incident channel didn't auto-open either — looks like the automation hook didn't trigger. anyone oncall?

oncall-sre: I'm oncall. seeing alerts for notify-broker 502s and delivery timeouts. list of affected customer ids: cust-981, cust-042, cust-210 (prelim). starting manual escalation. @ops-bot can you dump the last 100 delivery logs and queue TTL?

ops-bot: attaching log tail (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T12:27:58Z notify-broker ERROR deliver_post upstream=router-sentinel status=502 body="bad gateway"
2026-03-15T12:28:01Z routing-sentinel WARN ack_timeout id=cust-981 seq=4321
2026-03-15T12:29:12Z routing-sentinel ERROR auth=failed token_mismatch
2026-03-15T12:30:05Z notify-broker INFO enqueue id=cust-042 ttl=120s drop=false
```

jin: we pushed a tiny channel-filter regex change at 12:10 to routing-sentinel config (PR #442). could that be filtering out the dedicated paging channel? I didn't expect it to affect webhook auth.

sam: I rolled the filter at 12:11, it passed CI. I can immediately revert config if that helps.

maria: please don't revert yet — we need to confirm root cause first. logs show token_mismatch errors at 12:29, which looks like signing key issues between notify-broker and routing-sentinel. @leo do you see anything on the key rotation side?

leo: confirm — KMS key rotation completed at 12:25 but notify-broker got the updated token; routing-sentinel's sidecar didn't reload due to a crash-loop earlier. looks like routing-sentinel continued using the old key, returning 401 to our upstream, which bubbled up as 502 in notify-broker.

oncall-sre: ok, mitigation plan: 1) send manual pages to oncall via fallback (doing now), 2) restart routing-sentinel pods to pick up rotated token, 3) temporarily enable a passthrough fallback route on notify-broker so pages don't need routing-sentinel auth while we fix. who can run the restart?

jin: I can run the restart. running: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/routing-sentinel`

ops-bot: `kubectl` command accepted. rolling restart started. pod rollout: 3/3 updated.

pagerflow-bot: Manual pages sent to oncall group at 12:39 UTC. delivery_status=partial, recipients=oncall@redwood + ops-team.

leo: after restart, routing-sentinel pod logs show successful key fetch and auth handshake with notify-broker at 12:40:21Z. sample: `INFO auth=ok token_id=rot-2026-03-15-1225`

ops-bot: health checks green. notify-broker backlog drained: queue-depth dropped from 820 -> 5 in ~2m. delivery succeed count increasing.

maria: can someone confirm customers are receiving pages? CS reported a few customers said they got their alerts late. @emily can you coordinate with CS?

emily: pinged CS. initial feedback: ~40 affected customers got delayed pages (median delay 7m), 3 customers reported missed pages entirely and raised support tickets. raising incident to P1 for impact review and external comms. creating ticket now. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-081

sam: quick root-cause hypothesis: KMS rotation occurred but routing-sentinel crashed around the same time so it never picked up new key. the channel-filter change was a red herring. will add a guard in the deploy pipeline to ensure sidecar reloads on key rotate.

oncall-sre: agree. immediate follow-ups: (1) add alert for auth failures ratio > 1% over 5m, (2) add post-deploy smoke to validate token handshake with notify-broker, (3) create runbook step for manual fallback enable. I'll include ownership and timelines in the incident ticket.

maria: good. for mitigation timeline: pages resumed at 12:40 after restart and fallback. customer impact window ~12:28–12:40 UTC. marking impact severity: medium (delayed critical alerts).

cs-bot: CS notified for impacted customers; templated message queued for review by @emily.

emily: drafting customer message. will also attach timeline and mitigation steps. tagging leadership. :warning:

maria: leaving this thread for postmortem. tagging @leo @jin @sam to own the blameless RCA. I'll follow up with timeline and attach logs. thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :thumbsup:
